request.subject: PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT

layers.text: Widen the red scarf into a big plain bright red cloth that covers the whole neck, both shoulders and the chest below the jaw, plain flat bright red with no stripes. Recolour the dark grey-blue skin to a clear cornflower blue with navy blue shading. Change nothing else: keep the big head, the open jaws, the cream teeth and lower jaw, the eye, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
